title: Grade 12 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected chapter Surah Yusuf has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected chapter Surah Yusuf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected chapter Surah Yusuf.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Bequest? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bequest.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bequest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bequest has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.
   D. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Islamic Law? (1 mark)
   A. Say Administration of Islamic Law has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Islamic Law.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Administration of Islamic Law to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   D. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Scholars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain World Religions: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Science of Qur’an and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. C — Apply the teaching of Selected chapter Surah Yusuf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Bequest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. B — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim Scholars; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Science of Qur’an; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Science of Qur’an; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
